about.title: About the AMA Week
about.subtitle: Building Africa's Regulatory Future Together — From National Strength to Continental Impact
about.headerSubtitle: Six days and eleven convenings to launch the operational work programme of the African Medicines Agency, 25–30 October 2026 in Kigali.

executiveSummary.title: Background
executiveSummary.p1: The Treaty for the establishment of the African Medicines Agency was adopted by the Assembly of the African Union in February 2019 and entered into force in November 2021. AMA has been operational since October 2025, from its headquarters in Kigali, Rwanda.
executiveSummary.p2: Under the AMA Treaty, the Agency coordinates and strengthens continental regulatory systems: it provides scientific opinions on medical products of continental interest, promotes reliance and mutual recognition, strengthens the capacity of National Regulatory Authorities (NRAs) and Regional Economic Communities (RECs), and supports the harmonisation of regulatory requirements across the continent.
executiveSummary.p3: The 1st AMA Week consolidates the Agency's operational foundation: it advances the work of its Technical Committees, launches its Capacity Strengthening and Regulatory Innovation & Manufacturing Readiness Hubs, convenes Heads of National Regulatory Authorities in collaboration with WHO, and establishes a structured channel of engagement with industry.

background.title: General Objective
background.p1: To launch the operational work programme of the African Medicines Agency by convening its technical structures, so as to advance continental regulatory harmonisation, strengthen cooperation between NRAs, support local manufacturing and innovation, improve emergency preparedness, and establish AMA Week as a continental platform for regulatory cooperation, scientific exchange and collective action.
background.p2: AMA works with, and adds value to, national regulatory authorities, which remain the sole authorities for giving regulatory approvals in their countries in line with national laws. This distinction runs through the design of the 1st AMA Week.

objectives.title: AMA Week Objectives
objectives.obj1: Review progress in continental regulatory harmonisation against agreed benchmarks
objectives.obj2: Strengthen reliance, work-sharing and peer networks between NRAs and with AMA
objectives.obj3: Establish a structured channel for regulator–industry engagement and advance local manufacturing
objectives.obj4: Strengthen continental preparedness for regulatory response in public health emergencies
objectives.obj5: Build a sustainable approach to regulatory capacity strengthening through the AMA Capacity Strengthening Hub
objectives.obj6: Adopt the Technical Committee workplans and convene the Network of Heads of African NRAs

travelGuide.label: Travel Guide
travelGuide.title: Welcome to the Land of a Thousand Hills
travelGuide.p1: Kigali is widely known as one of Africa's cleanest, safest, and most dynamic cities. As the host city for the 1st AMA Week, it offers a perfect blend of world-class infrastructure and authentic Rwandan culture.
travelGuide.p2: Rwanda has simplified its visa process, with many nationalities eligible for visa-on-arrival or easy e-visas, supporting its mission to be a hub for continental dialogue.
